trophies.guide: This is the platinum, awarded when every other trophy on the official list is earned. Work through the roadmap stages in order, keep the checklist updated as you play, and use the missables panel before the final mission so no one-off moment is left behind.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission named in the official description, Gone Fishing, from start to finish. It introduces the story, so simply follow the mission prompts until it ends and the trophy registers.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 of the story. Story chapters cannot be skipped, so keep following the main markers and this unlocks as the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2 of the story. The chapter follows Chapter 1 in order, so progress the main story and the trophy lands when Chapter 2 ends.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3 of the story. Keep the main story moving after Chapter 2 and this unlocks at the end of the chapter.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4 of the story. It is the last numbered chapter named on the official list before the final mission, so complete it before turning to endgame clean-up.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.caution: This is the final mission named in the description: finish one-off moments and missable scenes before starting it, in case the story does not let you return to them afterwards.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story, as the official description states. Before you start it, clear the Stage 3 one-off moments in this guide, then play the finale through to its ending to earn this gold trophy.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run, named in the official description. Follow that mission to its end when it appears in the story and the trophy registers on completion.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, the mission named in the official description. Play that heist mission through its final step when the story offers it and the trophy unlocks at the end.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play, named in the official description. Follow it from its story marker to completion and the trophy registers automatically.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete Headliners, the mission named in the official description. Play it through when it appears in the story and finish its final objective to earn the trophy.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, the mission named in the official description. Note that VCIA is also the setting of the Catch Me If You Can moment, so watch for that one-off opportunity while you are there.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory, the mission named in the official description. Play that operation to its end when the story presents it and the trophy unlocks on completion.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100 percent completion as tracked by the game, as the official description requires. Use this checklist alongside the in-game completion counter: story, stranger strands, collections and activities in Stages 1 to 5 all feed this total, so leave it for the endgame.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts in total, the count given in the official description. Spread this grind across your whole playthrough instead of leaving it all for the end, and tick it off once the in-game counter reaches 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once, as the official description says; the starter data notes there are 9 activity types. Sample every activity category the game lists at least one time and the trophy unlocks when the last new type is tried.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 challenges in total, the count PlayStation tracks for this trophy. Work range by range, replay any challenge that ends below gold, and keep a note of which ones still need gold so none is missed.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location, 14 locations in total according to the tracked count behind this trophy. Win once at each distinct location rather than replaying a favourite, and track the locations here as you clear them.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races, as the official description states. Different is the key word: move to a new race after each win instead of repeating one event, until 20 separate wins are recorded.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge, the contest named in the official description. Take on Cal's challenge when fishing becomes available and finish ahead of him to earn the trophy.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.target: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, as the official description requires. Only a single completed arcade game is needed, so finish one in full rather than sampling several and stopping early.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy, as the official description states. Work through Andy's mission strand in order, and this unlocks when you finish the last mission in that strand.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton, as the official description states. Follow Kenton's strand to its last mission and finish it to earn the trophy.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy, as the official description states. Play Billy's strand through to its final mission and complete it.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida, the count in the official description. The named locals in this guide (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone) are part of this picture: finish whole strands, not just first meetings, and count them here until you reach 8.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy, as the official description states. Work Randy's strand in order and finish its last mission to earn the trophy.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone, as the official description states. Follow Tyrone's strand to its final mission and complete it.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in total, the count behind the official description. Treat the spots as a collection route, meditate at each new spot you pass, and keep count here so the last few are easy to find.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret, the task named in the official description. Take Bret's hunt when it is offered and complete that specific hunt; ordinary animals do not substitute for the unique one.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets, as the official description requires. Collect by set rather than at random: finish one set completely before spreading effort across others, and use this entry to note which sets are done until all 3 are complete.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It action at 100 different locations, the count in the official description. Build it into normal travel: do it whenever you arrive somewhere new, so the 100 locations accumulate without a dedicated grind at the end.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges in total, as the official description states. Pick up challenges as they appear during story and free roam, and check the remaining count here before the endgame so the shortfall is small.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.caution: This needs your partner with you and a 4-star wanted level that you then lose, per the description: set the sequence up deliberately in free roam instead of hoping it happens by chance.
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner, reach a 4 star Wanted Level and then lose it and escape the heat, exactly as the official description describes. Plan the attempt: raise the wanted level together, then break away and stay out of trouble until the heat clears while your partner is still with you.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.target: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner

trophies.caution: The description demands 3 shops back-to-back with your partner and without losing your Wanted Level in between: pick three close shops and do not let the heat drop mid-run.
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level, as the official description states. Choose a tight cluster of shops, move straight from one to the next with your partner, and keep the wanted level alive until the third robbery is done.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.target: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with partner, keep Wanted Level

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles, the count in the official description. Get into vehicles you have not used before whenever you see a new model, across all of Leonida, so discovery grows naturally toward 100.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus, as the official description requires. Wait for a moment with at least five enemies in reach, trigger Combat Focus once, and land all five takedowns before that single use ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.caution: The unscheduled departure happens at VCIA, the setting of the VCIA Takedown mission in the official list: try it while that mission has you there, because returning later may not offer the same chance.
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, as the official description puts it. VCIA is the location of the VCIA Takedown mission on this list, so while you are there for that mission, look for a way to leave that is not the scheduled, expected route.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: This trophy concerns Rhinos, the tanks named in its official description. When a Rhino confrontation occurs, survive and deal with the tank rather than fleeing, and the trophy should register from that encounter.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected, exactly as the official description states. Approach quietly, avoid raising any alarm or attention during the robbery, and get out clean; if you are spotted, try again at another attempt.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape after each one, the count and condition in the official description. A vault only counts with a successful escape, so plan your exit before starting each robbery and tally the clean getaways here.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape, as the official description requires. Stop and open a truck when you encounter one, take what it carries, and complete the escape so the robbery counts.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: 52 areas in total, the count behind the official description. Travel region by region instead of staying in one city, and use the other collection routes in Stage 4 to carry you into areas you would otherwise never visit.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang: 9 gangs in total, as counted behind the official description. Variety matters more than volume, so note which gangs you have already hit and seek out an operation of each remaining gang.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.target: Rob 1 Illegal Operation of each of 9 gangs

trophies.caution: A cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach reads as an early, quiet moment in the description: take it when Ocean Beach is first available rather than assuming it waits until the endgame.
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, the scene in the official description. When you are on Ocean Beach, stop for that cocktail-with-a-view moment instead of rushing past; do it early, while the moment is naturally available.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.target: Cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach

trophies.caution: Smashing out of a vehicle showroom is a single scene in the description: when a story beat puts you inside a showroom, drive out through it instead of leaving on foot or reloading.
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style, as the official description describes. When the game places you in a vehicle showroom, get in a vehicle and drive out through the showroom front rather than exiting normally.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.target: Smash out of a vehicle showroom

trophies.caution: This is tied to one named place, the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in the description: complete its follow-through when that alley scene happens, as it may be a one-scene opportunity.
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Complete the follow-through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, the named location in the official description. When that bowling alley scene arrives, play it through and finish the follow-through there rather than leaving the activity incomplete.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.target: Follow-through at Kolt & Associates bowling alley

trophies.caution: The description is a single partnership moment with mass appeal: when a partner scene draws a crowd or an audience, stay in it and finish it rather than walking away mid-scene.
trophies.guide: This trophy is a partnership moment with mass appeal, in the words of its official description. When a scene with your partner builds toward a public, crowd-pleasing moment, see that scene through to its end so the moment registers.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.caution: Choices made for better or worse cannot be unmade, per the description: the count builds from decisions across the story, so keep making tracked choices and do not reload them away.
trophies.guide: Make choices, for better or worse, as the official description says; PlayStation tracks this to a count of 500. Engage with the choice prompts the game presents throughout the story and free roam instead of skipping them, and let the decisions stand so the count keeps growing to 500.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.caution: Second time's the charm means a first attempt must fail before a retry can succeed, per the description: if you succeed first try everywhere, you may need to deliberately retry something, so watch for a natural failure early.
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try, as the official description puts it: something must be attempted, missed, and then completed on the retry. Let a failed attempt stand and immediately try again, succeeding the second time, rather than reloading to erase the failure.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.caution: Witnessing something strange, per the description, is likely a brief chance event: when something odd starts happening, stop and witness it fully instead of driving away.
trophies.guide: Witness something strange, the event hinted at by the official description and its startled subtitle. Explore off the main path, and when an unusual event begins, stay and watch it play out completely so you count as having witnessed it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by, as the official description describes: from a moving vehicle, use a melee attack as you pass a target so they are bowled over by the drive-by. Repeat the pass until the knockdown registers cleanly.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn 250,000 dollars laundering Marked Bills through your contacts, the amount and method in the official description. Route marked bills to your contacts whenever you hold them instead of spending them directly, and track the laundered total here until it reaches 250,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend 100,000 dollars across all shops, as the official description states. Normal upgrading and buying counts toward it, so spend steadily as you play and avoid hoarding cash that could be pushing this total up.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties: 8 garages in total, the count behind the official description. Buy each garage as funds allow across the whole map, and keep a list here so the final, easily forgotten garage is not left unbought.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, as the official description requires. Register each new vehicle you take while exploring, rather than only your favourites, so the 10 registrations accumulate quickly.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.target: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app
